notes.title: Changes to the file browser
notes.notes: The file browser has been changed. This change is for future Steam Deck support.

notes.title: Changes have been made to separate save data for each Steam user.
notes.notes:
We have made a change so that save data is separated by Steam user.
As a result, all previous saves will be initialized.
The same applies to the DEMO version.
Considering that current sales figures are in the single digits and the number of active players is almost zero, we do not think that many people will be affected, but if you would like to restore your saves, please ask in the requests thread on the message board, and we will explain the steps to manually restore your saves.

In addition, due to changes to the save data structure, the Early Access version will undergo detailed updates to make it compatible with Steam Cloud. We will make another announcement when cloud-compatible functionality has been implemented in the Early Access version.[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900617/9156d1b71c595215fa46a20a5f7a1392c3634683.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44900617/324ab1db29c26351c96e78bb22df252fdf869dbc.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: UI changes etc.
notes.notes: Reward acquisition conditions are now displayed when you hover your cursor over the key icon of an unearned reward. Other minor changes were made, such as making the image lighter. If you have any other requests, please let us know on the bulletin board.

notes.title: Significant changes to user interface (UI)
notes.notes: We have made major changes to the user interface. As a result, the layout of interactive buttons and items has been organized. Minor corrections will be made from time to time.
